title: Resource failures by type
sqlTemplate: select resource_type, count(*) as resources, count(*) filter (where resource_status_code >= 400 or resource_status_code = 0) as failed_resources from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'resource' group by resource_type order by failed_resources desc limit 20
emptyDataSemantics: No matching resource records -> an empty result set (zero rows).
